description: Test vectors of the KeyPlan payload (docs/reference/signed-config.md 'The payload'; the strict profile of docs/reference/bootstrap-file.md): the payload text, and either what both readers must read from it or the path that a refusal must contain. store@ (Rust, actors/store/tests/vectors.rs) and key@ (Go, actors/key/internal/keyd/plan_vectors_test.go) read the same file. A refusal in each language starts or contains the path; the wording of the rest differs.

cases.name: the local KeyPlan source
cases.payload:
# KeyPlan: which keys exist and where they live (keys.yaml). The software key driver ignores the
# slots; a board's card follows them.
default:
  cache_ttl: 15m
  # The wrap recipients: the RFC 7638 thumbprint of each node's wrapping key, and no one else receives a wrap of a
  # data key (ADR 0006, "Who may receive a wrap"). A software key is made at the first start, so the committed list
  # is empty and the harness fills it in when it signs: deploy/local/local.sh up, deploy/boards/prepare.sh. They
  # replace the line below, which must stay as it is.
  recipients: []
  purposes:
    - { purpose: wrapping, algorithm: ECDH-P384, slot: 9d }
    - { purpose: token-signing, algorithm: ES384, slot: 9a }
    - { purpose: audit-log, algorithm: ES256, slot: "84" }
    - { purpose: data, algorithm: AES-256-GCM }

no recipients key and no purposes
recipients null
a quoted slot that looks like a number
cases.payload:
